title: [FR] Delocalize delayed VAT and SEPA payment-slip integration
summary: Moved French delayed VAT and SEPA direct debit payment-slip features from base layers to the Payment Management FR app, while maintaining reusable posting and calculation engines in the base application.
key_points: Moved journal-context fields and the unrealized application buffer into Payment Management FR, with data migration
Delayed VAT recognition and percentage validation now run through app subscribers using standard VAT calculation
Moved source-document export-error linking into the app and corrected the error FactBox reference
SEPA direct debit export now supports filtered and temporary entries while keeping ordinary collections working
Updated permissions, data classification and cloud-migration lists without adding dependencies
quote: Complete the remaining French delayed-VAT and payment-slip SEPA direct-debit extraction into the existing Payment Management FR app.
